direct_file_reviews.summary: Clean-room reverse engineering prompt and restrictions, identical to the parallel prompt.
Serial metadata confirms no parallel use or subagents and 73 of 1085 tests passed.
Current completed official evaluation records solution_passed false with 73 passes, 1011 failures, and one skipped test.
Evaluator summary reports no compile error and a partial test pass count for the serial submission.
Final response file is empty after timeout, matching the incomplete but packaged serial attempt.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport stream for the serial run; semantic reconstruction uses the projected raw agent source.
Single-agent serial trajectory: probed the binary and docs, wrote a C++ implementation, built successfully, then timed out with partial behavior.

parallel.requirements: Reimplement 7za from behavioral observation and bundled docs only, without source lookup, wrapping, or forbidden binary analysis.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent probed basics, launched a broad behavior survey, scaffolded a C++ project, then launched a codec workflow assigning hashers, AES, compression, filters, and related modules to children.
parallel.implementation: Scaffold files and hashers landed; AES reached a header; many compression and archive components were only probed or interrupted and no complete codec/archive stack was assembled.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact packaged partial src files, README, docs, compile.sh, and executable, but the source set was incomplete for compilation.
parallel.verification: Some child-local checks passed, notably hashers, but there was no final integrated build/test loop before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed with compile_failed and all 1085 tests not run, showing the submitted source tree was not buildable.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room 7za reimplementation constraints and probed CLI behavior through normal execution and bundled documentation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent performed probing, then wrote the project structure, core utilities, option parsing, hashing, scanning, commands, and build script itself.
serial.implementation: Produced a broad partial C++ implementation with hash/info support and placeholder archive/benchmark behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Created compile.sh, built an executable successfully, and included that executable in the final artifact.
serial.verification: Ran compile.sh successfully before closure, but did not complete evaluator-aligned behavior for most archive commands.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation failed overall despite 73 passing tests because archive behavior was largely missing or placeholder.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the clean-room 7za reimplementation task and the need to observe behavior without forbidden source or binary analysis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run saw the same prompt and also worked from docs and normal CLI observations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference is visible at the prompt level; the later gap comes from execution and delivery rather than prompt understanding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work into a behavior survey workflow and a codec workflow, with many subagents owning narrow probes or modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained ownership in one trajectory, probing and then building the project itself.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel depended on child lifecycle recovery; serial avoided delegation boundaries and kept implementation ownership local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The codec workflow supplied common interface headers and told children not to change shared headers except assigned files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial defined interfaces and implementations together in one context, writing headers and callers in sequence.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had explicit module contracts but still needed parent recovery when modules failed; serial had fewer handoff boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced scaffold files and a completed hashers module, but AES reached only header creation and other codecs remained partial or interrupted.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a broad command framework, hashing, options, filesystem, and placeholders for archive behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial implemented enough to compile and exercise some commands; parallel left required codec implementation incomplete enough to break compilation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: A required AES child was interrupted immediately after creating aes.h, and several codec siblings were also interrupted before usable module returns.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child-result lifecycle; it directly incorporated its own writes and built them.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel needed a takeover or reassign step for cancelled child work, while serial did not have that recovery boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The final artifact contained scaffold and some child-produced files, including hashers and aes.h, but no complete compilable implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial artifact included src files, compile.sh, build output, and executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel integration stopped at an incomplete source tree; serial assembled and linked its partial project.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Hashers had local self-tests, but the parallel run lacked a final integrated compile/test acceptance loop.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran compile.sh successfully before packaging, though it did not achieve full behavioral correctness.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verified an isolated component but never closed whole-build verification; serial at least proved the submitted tree built.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 56 subagents, two workflow tasks, and timed out with process_ok false.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents and also timed out, but spent the run in one implementation path and left a runnable binary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted time, but parallel closed with unrecovered delegated work while serial converted its time into a buildable partial deliverable.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail, but the trajectories differ materially. Parallel coordination produced unrecovered cancelled codec work and a compile_failed artifact, so no tests ran. Serial remained incomplete at the feature level but built a runnable partial executable and passed 73 tests.
parallel_contributors: Delegated required codec work was cancelled or partial, and the parent did not take over enough to restore a buildable source tree.
serial_contributors: Serial kept implementation and integration in one context, wrote compile.sh, and built an executable before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still left archive commands as not implemented, explaining its many functional failures independent of concurrency.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors to a quality gap, not an exclusive root cause for a discordant official outcome

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel parent delegated required codec implementation, observed children being cancelled or left partial, and closed without taking over or reassigning enough of that work to produce a buildable tree.
